products.description:
An always-on, compliance-gated VPN tunnel for every managed Windows device

Remote workers need a VPN that just works — always on, no manual reconnecting — and access over it must be limited to trusted, healthy devices. This solution deploys the Windows Always On VPN user tunnel through Microsoft Intune (IKEv2 with SSTP fallback, user-certificate auth) and gates corporate access with Entra Conditional Access, so the tunnel auto-connects when the user signs in and only a compliant or hybrid-joined device reaches corporate resources through it. Deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — user tunnel vs. device tunnel, the profile-plus-certificate-plus-policy model, IKEv2/SSTP + Always On, and where this fits vs. the companion device-tunnel product (which owns the full certificate lifecycle).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing + enrolled Windows devices, Entra user groups, a VPN head-end/RRAS or Azure VPN Gateway, a lean user-cert SCEP path + trusted root, Conditional Access availability, a device compliance policy) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to build the trusted root, the user SCEP certificate, the VPN template profile, and the Conditional Access policy, assign to a named pilot user group, then validate, pilot, and expand fleet-wide.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — deployment-readiness discovery (incl. the Conditional Access policy), on-device tunnel + user-cert validation, a coverage report, safe remediation of errored devices, and a user target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An always-on, compliance-gated VPN user tunnel on every managed Windows device — delivered from Intune, enforced by Conditional Access, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AOVUT-Discovery.ps1 — Always On VPN user-tunnel + Conditional Access deployment-readiness discovery across Entra + Intune
    • AOVUT-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix errored user-tunnel profiles / missing profile assignments
    • AOVUT-Report.ps1 — Always On VPN user tunnel + user certificate coverage report across the fleet
    • AOVUT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the pilot (and production) Entra USER group(s)
    • AOVUT-Validation.ps1 — confirm the Always On VPN user tunnel + user certificate are applied on THIS device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
